leftEvidence.title: Adam’s trespass is set beside Christ’s gift

points.label: Problem named
points.left: Paul repeatedly sets one trespass, condemnation, death, and disobedience beside the gift, righteousness, obedience, grace, and life through Jesus Christ.
points.right: Paul says all die in Adam and will be made alive in Christ, then orders resurrection, reign, enemies, death’s defeat, and final subjection.

points.label: Source setting
points.left: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · Romans 5:15–21
points.right: Adam, Christ, and embodied life · later memory · 1 Corinthians 15:20–28

payload.posture: Trespass, condemnation, disobedience, gift, righteousness, and life are paired is held beside Death in Adam and life in Christ lead into resurrection order, reign, and death’s defeat.

rightEvidence.title: Death in Adam stands beside life in Christ

payload.tension: Both passages pair Adam and Christ, but one centers on trespass and gift while the other centers on resurrection and the end.
payload.title: Adam and Christ across two letters
